summary: Settings got reorganized again! Some modules got moved into new categories. Quick Items have been redone too: you can now pin convertibles and message items right to the top menu directly in the Custom Menu, rather than configuring them separately.

details.title: Settings
items: New categories: Interface, Journal, Maps & Mice, Quests & Tournaments, and Progress & Stats
Hover Profiles, Emotes, and Scoreboard Search are now combined into a new module: Better Friends
Quick Send Supplies and pinned Send Supplies items are now part of Better Send Supplies

details.title: Quick Items & Custom Menu
items: Custom Menu: Pin items to the top menu, on their own or in a group
Custom Menu: Added a Dark Mode toggle, and more links from the main menu

details.title: Fixed and Updated
items: Dark Mode: More styles and improvements
Better Mice: King's Crowns power type mastery lists have been fixed
Better Mice: Fixed King's Crowns conflicting with Profile+ userscript
